subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the upgraded third-party GitHub Action contracts on the final PR head after final-head workflow evidence is available?
rationale: The patch updates externally supplied code in privileged CI and release paths; accepting the trust and permission implications requires repository-owner security judgment.

options.title: Accept after final-head review
options.body: Review the upstream action changes and final-head workflow evidence, then merge if the privileged paths retain their intended behavior.

options.title: Hold for targeted owner validation
options.body: Pause the update until the owners of the app-token, Docker release, CodeQL, and Codex-agent workflows validate the affected action contracts.

recommendation.title: Accept after final-head review
recommendation.body: Review the upstream action changes and final-head workflow evidence, then merge if the privileged paths retain their intended behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only supplied security-routing signal; the available read-only context does not identify an individual workflow/security owner.
